title: Clear a brad-nailer nose jam and secure its draw latch
instruction: The tool is unpowered and its driver is retracted. Open the nose, remove the bent brad into the tray, then close the nose and secure the latch pin under both arms. Leave the tool and both hands clear.
context: Carpenters use nail guns for core fastening work; BLS reports889,700 workers in2025. This original unpowered service fixture isolates manufacturer-documented jam removal and two-arm latch recapture; no OEM dimensional compatibility is claimed.
setup: Standard two-arm YAM station, table z0.7475m. Original side-mounted service fixture origin(0.25,0.06,0.805)m, rotated180deg aboutX; firing axis+X/service−Y. Empty magazine, absent battery, retracted driver, locked trigger preparation. Five colliding nose/door/lever/bail/crosspin bodies, free0.5g pre-bent brad and fixed80x90mm parts tray at(0.24,-0.28,0.7495)m. Authored52mm crosspin engages capture arms at z=±12mm;20kN/m compliant draw bail starts0.5mm preloaded. Full original solid dimensions, all four enabled joint contacts, body masses/COM/inertias and resets appear in scene.json and PARAMETERS.md. Visible original bench workholding; no supplied OEM accessory implied.
scoring: 0.25 when door opens at least1rad or every brad collider clears the nose by5mm;0.5 when every brad collider lies inside the tray;0.75 additionally requires door within0.005rad, both pin ends under both arms, draw extension>=0.1mm, lever -0.06..0.01rad and tensile length derivative<=-0.5mm/rad. Full score requires2s pairwise witness drift<=0.5mm and robot clearance>=20mm. Credit is current state; invalid joint/body consistency, penetration>0.20mm, fixture motion or fastener loss latch zero.
reset_notes: Seed0/no jitter. Restore explicit roots and passive joints, zero velocities and independent spring rest targets; clear all histories. Prepared preload is not spring equilibrium.
fidelity: Original benchmark-authored dimensions preserve manufacturer sequence and external door/lever/pin-under-two-arms topology. Hidden eccentric, compliant draw cartridge, masses, friction and gripper-access projections and workholding height are authored. No OEM force/dimension, native Isaac, physical hardware or Dream success claim. See FIDELITY.md.
